"""Spawn a Git-only following publisher only after the old one actually releases."""
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now,file_sha256
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025'
prior=read_json(folder/'publisher-state.json')
if prior['status']!='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline' or (folder/'publisher.lock').exists():
 print(json.dumps({'started':False,'reason':'prior_publisher_or_its_actual_readback_still_live','prior_status':prior['status'],'prior_observed_at_utc':prior['observed_at_utc']},ensure_ascii=True));sys.exit(0)
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v6'
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (folder/f'publisher-{run}.json').exists()
receipt=folder/'v6-publisher-launch.json';assert not receipt.exists()
script=ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-publisher-following-run-20261025.py'
log_path=folder/'v6-publisher.log'
with log_path.open('xb') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(script),run],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
body={'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'run_id':run,'pid':p.pid,'status':'process_spawned_state_not_yet_confirmed','prior_finished_state':prior,'prior_publisher_lock_observed_absent':True,'helper_path':script.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'helper_sha256':file_sha256(script),'log_path':log_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'scope':'Hidden Git-only child. This launch receipt alone does not prove its unique lock/state was claimed, a snapshot committed or original PNG bytes verified. No image call or canonical portrait write.'}
write_json(receipt,body)
print(json.dumps({'started':True,'pid':p.pid,'run_id':run,'launch_receipt':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'state_confirmation_required':True},ensure_ascii=True))
